Subject: CAIQ annotation: log-access sampling and retention SLA exception

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — we're in the final pass of our CSA/CAIQ review. Two asks from our security and procurement teams:

1) Evidence samples for a couple of controls we flagged in the CAIQ: CCM-ET-01 (log access & sampling) and CCM-DR-04 (retention controls). Could you provide a short control annotation and a redacted log sample (1–2 days) we can use during the review?

2) Procurement would like to request an SLA exception to extend system log retention from Redwood's default 90 days to 180 days for the scoped environment. Please confirm whether Redwood can approve a temporary (contract-level) exception and, if so, the internal approval path and any form you need filled out. We need a decision (or a target approval path) by EOD Wed Nov 3 to keep our timeline.

I've attached a small CAIQ excerpt (row IDs) to make the mapping easier. Let me know who on your side is best to pull the artifacts.

Thanks,
Ben Jenkins
Security Operations
Orion Health
ben.jenkins@orionhealth.com

Attachment: caiq_control_excerpt.pdf

Ben — thanks for the clear asks. We can take this on. Quick plan below:

- Marissa (cc'd) will pull a redacted 24-hour sample and a short control annotation for CCM-ET-01. Expect a CSV sample + short write-up by EOD Tue Nov 2.
- Grace (cc'd) will draft a retention-policy note and call out what a 180-day exception would mean operationally (controls, cost delta, and monitoring). Expect that same Tue timeline.
- For the SLA exception: we need a completed exception form and a security review sign-off. If Orion can send the retention_exception_form.docx back with the requested fields, we can route it through our security review and legal. I will drive the approval path internally but need Marissa/Grace artifacts to complete risk notes.

If anything is time-sensitive beyond the EOD Wed target, flag it and we will prioritize.

Naomi Feldman

Naomi / Ben — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Notes below.

Attachments: log_sample_20271030.csv, caiq_control_excerpt.pdf

1) Log sample: redacted event set from 2027-10-30 (token/user IDs hashed, IPs truncated). This is a 24-hour sample pulled from the production ingestion pipeline for the scoped tenant. Columns: timestamp, service, event_type, actor_id_hash, action, outcome.

2) Control annotations (in the PDF): I mapped the CAIQ rows you sent to our internal control IDs and included the short narrative for CCM-ET-01 and CCM-DR-04. The CCM-ET-01 annotation calls out:
   - how access to logs is gated (IAM roles + just-in-time temporary lift),
   - sampling approach (1-in-100 for high-volume services; full capture for auth/error streams), and
   - retention buckets we operate (90d default, 180d cold store option).

3) Retention exception: Grace and I estimated the storage delta for 180d retention at ~0.6TB per tenant per year for the scoped environment; that's the rough cost input into the exception review. If Orion wants Redwood to be the custodian for the 180d window we will require a signed exception and a brief runbook for access auditing.

If you want us to redact further or produce a smaller sample (6–12 hours) for legal, say the word and we'll trim it.

-Marissa
Sr. Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
